scope: Documentary records and public-safe research correspondence associated with Alexander Glasgow. Y-DNA results, profile-only vital claims and broad research leads are excluded.

records.association: Tithe Applotment: Alexr Glasgow at Lisnagaver
records.note: The entry gives Alexander 29 acres at Lisnagaver. It supplies no age or relationship and is not independently proved to be the later Alexander.

records.association: Lisnagaver valuation field-book house and land sections
records.role: Contextual non-appearance; not a named subject
records.status: Maintained original-image reading; limited negative evidence
records.note: Pages194–197 name Robert Glasgow and Archibald McCaughan junior in the house section but not Alexander. Land parcels have no occupier names, so absence does not establish no landholding, co-residence or inheritance.

records.association: James Glasgow baptism, Rasharkin entry 75
records.note: The transcription names Alex Glascaw and Mary McAughin as the parents.

records.association: Unnamed Glasgow child baptism, Rasharkin entry 106
records.note: The entry names Alex and Molly McAughern. This is the concrete record represented by the related Unknown Glasgow profile; the child's forename and baptism date were not preserved in the published transcription.

records.association: James Glasgow baptism, Rasharkin entry 203
records.note: The transcription names Alex and Molly McAughern as the parents of James, born 9 October 1843.

records.association: Lisnagaver household 35 census return
records.note: Five original rows: Alexander 40, farmer, reads/writes; Mary 40, reads; both married, first marriage 1836; Robert 10 and James 7, sons at school, read; Ann 4, daughter. All give Antrim birthplaces. No other person row is completed.

records.association: Griffith's Valuation: Alexander at Lisnagaver
records.note: Alexander and Thomas appear at Lisnagaver, with Daniel and Robert at adjoining Gortereghy. The entries support a local network but do not prove kinship.

records.association: PRONI valuation revision books, Lisnagaver lot 25
records.note: Alexander's name continues on lot 25 beside John and Thomas Glasgow. Valuation continuity does not establish his death date or parentage.

records.association: PRONI valuation revision books: Alexander struck from Lisnagaver lot 25
records.note: The later volume records changes in 1881, 1882 and 1886; Robert Elder occupied the lot by the next volume. This narrows the land change but does not prove Alexander's death date.

records.association: Robert Glasgow and Jane Graham marriage
records.note: Robert named Alexander Glasgow, farmer, as his father.

records.association: Robert Elder and Mary Glasgow marriage
records.note: Mary, of Lisnagaver, named Alexander Glasgow, farmer, as her father.

records.association: Robert McCracken and Ann Glasgow marriage
records.note: Ann named Alexander Glasgow, labourer, as her father and was associated with Lisnagaver.

records.association: Jane Matilda Elder civil birth return
records.note: Jane Matilda Elder was born to farmer Robert Elder and Mary Elder, whose maiden surname is entered as Glass. The exact parents, place and middle initial identify the later Jane M. Elder and directly continue Alexander's daughter's family.

records.association: Alexander Glasgow civil death register
records.note: Entry 348 records Alexander Glasgow, married labourer aged 84, dying 16 May 1888 at Gortahar; daughter Nancy Glasgow, of Gortahar, present at death; registered 25 May. The Elder-family bridge supports Glasgow-951 over the weaker Glenleslie namesake, but age and Nancy’s identity remain unresolved.

records.association: Mary Glasgow civil death register
records.timeline_role: Record of the presumed spouse's death; daughter Mary Elder informed
records.note: Mary died at Gortahar as a widow; daughter Mary Elder informed the death, linking the later Elder household to the Lisnagaver family.

records.association: Robert Elder civil death register
records.note: Robert Elder, married farmer, aged 64, died at Gortahar; Mary Elder, widow, of Gortahar informed the death. The return does not explicitly call her his wife.

records.association: Mary Jane Elder civil death register
records.note: A later Elder record retained in the profile's family reconstruction; it does not identify Alexander's parents.

records.association: Elder household continuation in Gortahar and Lisnagaver
records.note: The original 1901 and 1911 forms continue Mary, Robert and Jane Elder at Gortahar. The 1911 manuscript calls the child Samuel Glasgow while his original 1908 birth records Samuel Elder; the alternate surname is unexplained and does not identify his father.

records.association: Daniel Glasgow will, proved 1871
records.note: The will calls Thomas Glasgow Daniel's late brother and Daniel Neely Glasgow his nephew. It establishes Daniel and Thomas as brothers and supplies the nephew bridge; it does not name Alexander.

records.association: Daniel Neely Glasgow and Mary Jane Boyd marriage
records.role: Thomas Glasgow identified as father of groom
records.place: Boveedy First Presbyterian Church, County Londonderry
records.note: The marriage return names Thomas Glasgow, farmer, as Daniel Neely's father. Together with Daniel's will, the full name identifies the relevant Thomas as Daniel's brother, not merely a same-named neighbour. It does not connect Alexander.

records.association: Private correspondence: reported autosomal connection to Thomas's descendants
records.note: A correspondent reported descent from Thomas and repeated the Alexander-and-Rosanna tradition. Match metrics, segment data, complete descent and the source behind the parent names remain outstanding; private message text is not published.
